style.summary: clean flat vector-style scientific illustration with soft pastel fills, friendly and refined, identical to the previously generated icon set of this figure
style.line: one uniform thin dark navy outline (#1F2937), identical weight on every element
style.shading: flat fills with one soft shadow tone, light from the upper left, no gradients

sheet_rules: All elements are small icons in the same drawn style, same outline weight and same palette, as if drawn by one illustrator for a journal figure. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere in any element. No letters, digits or words inside any element.

elements.label: human
elements.description: a friendly young researcher with black hair and round glasses, head and shoulders, light blue shirt, smiling, seen from the front

elements.label: agent
elements.description: a friendly round-headed white robot head and shoulders with dark navy face screen and two blue dot eyes, small antenna, seen from the front, no headphones, no book

elements.label: primary_agent
elements.description: a friendly white robot, head and upper body, one hand raised in a wave, navy face screen with two blue eyes, small antenna, seen from the front, no headphones

elements.label: subagents
elements.description: two small friendly robots side by side, one teal and one light blue, each with a navy face screen and small antenna, seen from the front

elements.label: knowledge
elements.description: a stack of two closed books in green and navy with an open book lying on top, light blue pages, seen from slightly above

elements.label: proposal
elements.description: a rolled blueprint sheet in light green with a simple network diagram of small boxes and lines, a yellow pencil and a green set-square triangle beside it

elements.label: decision
elements.description: a wooden signpost with two arrow-shaped boards pointing opposite ways in orange and yellow, with a small green check badge on the upper board

elements.label: metacognition
elements.description: a purple-and-navy clipboard with check boxes, a magnifying glass held in front of it, and a small gear at the lower right

elements.label: execution
elements.description: a grey gear with a wrench crossed over it, navy outline

elements.label: doc_gears
elements.description: a document page with abstract grey lines and two interlocking gears at its lower right, one blue and one orange

elements.label: bubble_h
